name: Goodbye, My Once and Forever
overview:
A wealthy heiress begins a relationship with a man in college and makes a five-year bet with her parents. She never expects betrayal. Yet, in the fifth year, her husband brings home his assistant. While she is asleep, his assistant gives their son a glass of wine. Furious, she demands accountability, but her husband defends his assistant, telling her not to overreact. Torn and heartbroken, she decides to file for divorce.

(Source: dramaboxapp.com)
